messages:
maya: quick q — when a request has both model_variant_fallback and region_fallback configured, which do we prefer? do we pick a compatible cheaper variant in same region or same model in fallback region? this affects latency for Dedicated. @sato @devon

devon: my reading of current impl: model_variant then region. iirc that's because variant is same infra, lower perf cost. but we never made that an explicit contract.

sato: i ran a perf sweep last night — model_variant-first saved ~180–240ms p95 vs region-first. logs: ```json
{"test":"fallback-pref","variant_first_p95_ms":420,"region_first_p95_ms":600}
``` i'll paste chart in PR.

liam: ok can we add that explicit rule to convo API doc + runtime lint. also streaming semantics: are we locking event_type names? proposal: use 'response.delta', 'response.tool_call', 'response.final'. keep 'event_type' string stable and non-nullable.

maya: +1 on naming. are we ok making event_type required for streaming chunks? some clients assume nullable role fields which caused churn.

devon: i'd prefer event_type required in stream envelope; role nullable still allowed in message payload for older clients, but we should warn.

deploy-bot: canary deploy convo-contract-lint v0.3 -> staging :rocket:  (build 2026-03-16T22:13Z)

sato: i'll open PR with fallback precedence doc, lint rule, and a tiny integration test. branch: sato/fallback-docs. @maya i'll add a changelog entry if you want.

maya: thanks — please link the test case pattern. i'll file a quick code-review ping when ready. :thumbsup:
